claims.reason: The mixture-of-LoRAs claim is an ARCH novelty the authors state as their own ('novel modality extension', 'novel mixture of LoRAs'). Coder2's page-11 sentence only contrasts the frozen-LoRA design against other models' fully fine-tuned baselines on public benchmarks; it is not a controlled with-vs-without ablation at matched size, data, and tokens, so ablation is NO.
